{{Quote|Karagga is the most powerful Hutt in the galaxy, and he rules the Hutt Cartel with an iron fist. By his decree, the Hutt Cartel has invaded no less than ten of its neighboring systems in the last month.|Ambassador [[Rove (Ambassador)|Rove]]|<ref name="Karagga" />}}
During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] '''annexed''' ten neutral [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] on the edges of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] over the course of a [[Standard month/Legends|month]] in order to replace territory lost in a recent [[Attacks on Hutt Space|string of attacks]] by an [[Dread Host|unknown force]]. Among the systems conquered by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] was the [[Vyron system/Legends|Vyron system]], and its [[Annexation of the Vyron system|annexation]] spurred the Republic to send a team to [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] to find out [[Karagga]]'s reasoning at the same time the Empire sent a similar group for the same purpose.<ref name="Karagga" />
